summary: Selectis Health filed an 8-K after Black Pearl Equities II's $5.75 per-share cash tender offer expired August 31, 2026, with 2,789,027 shares, about 90.93% of outstanding stock, validly tendered and not withdrawn, satisfying the minimum tender condition. Merger Sub accepted payment, and a short-form merger under Utah Revised Business Corporation Act Section 16-10a-1108 will convert remaining shares into the same $5.75 cash without a stockholder vote, making Selectis an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. Watch completion mechanics and any appraisal-rights dissent.
